# Why this section exists

A frozen language model only knows what it was trained on. Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is one way to give it fresh, inspectable context: retrieve, then generate. Agents add a loop — tools, memory, and a next step — on top of that.

I am not starting with a hedge-fund fantasy. The first honest pages here should be a small pipeline a student can follow.
